name: design-proto
title_zh: 原型直接长在真实代码库里的高保真打样器
tagline_zh: 别人给你看 Figma 图，它给你看能跑的代码。先翻你仓库里的组件和设计令牌，能复用就不新建，动土前先问你一声。
tagline_en: Skip the Figma-to-code gap. It inspects your components & tokens, reuses what exists, and asks before adding.
desc_en: Track A high-fidelity prototyping — build prototypes directly in the real frontend codebase using the real, shipped design system, so what gets built is accurate to what will ship rather than a visual approximation. Inspects the codebase's components and tokens first, then reuses existing components by default and asks permission before creating new ones. Requires live repo access via Claude Code.
why_zh: 产物即交付物，跳过视觉稿到代码的翻译损耗。默认复用现有组件，新组件需授权。
why_en: What you prototype is what ships. Reuses existing UI by default, requires permission for new components — no translation loss.
limit_zh: 必须通过 Claude Code 连接活仓库，离线或纯静态设计稿场景无法工作。只认代码库内已有的设计系统。
limit_en: Requires live repo access via Claude Code. Only works where a component library & design tokens already exist; empty projects stall.
title_en: High-fidelity prototyping directly inside your real codebase
